items.answer: Given, ten observations are written in an ascending order. The observations are 6, 14, 15, 17, x + 1, 2x - 13, 30, 32, 34, 43 The median of the data is 24 We have to find the value of x. Total number of observations, n = 10 Here, n is even The formula for median when n is even is given by Median = [(n/2)th observation + ((n/2) + 1)th observation] / 2 So, median = [(10/2)th observation + ((10/2) + 1)th observation] / 2 24 = [5th observation + (5 + 1)th observation] / 2 24 = [5th observation + 6th observation] / 2 24 = [(x + 1) + (2x - 13)]/2 48 = x + 2x + 1 - 13 48 = 3x - 12 3x = 48 + 12 3x = 60 x = 60/3 x = 20 Therefore, the value of x is 20.
